registry.contract: as, children, shell, round; host controls layout and radius
registry.result: Correct four-corner/elliptical contour, cached masks and smooth shared clock; real Chrome resize and preference transitions pass.

registry.name: Beacon
registry.contract: active, color, children
registry.result: Browser render verified; shares observer cleanup and global reduced-motion fixes.

registry.name: Equalizer
registry.contract: bars, playing, levels, phase, label
registry.result: Existing declarative live/bounce modes retained; visible browser render verified.

registry.name: GlowText

registry.result: Original neon character retained; duplicate halo is aria-hidden.

registry.name: ImageShine
registry.contract: src required, glow, label
checks: four-theme browser gallery with inline SVG image
registry.result: Image and shine render with accessible group label and decorative image copies.

registry.name: Marquee
registry.contract: duration, reverse, children; hover/focus pause
registry.result: Copy is natively inert, full content wraps when motion is disabled, actual clock pauses on hover/focus.

registry.name: MelodixText
registry.contract: string children, as, finish silver/theme/ink, glow
registry.result: Static typography rendered; font asset packaging checked by root package consumer workflow.

registry.name: Reveal
registry.contract: as, rise/fade/zoom/blur, stagger, repeat
checks: four-theme browser gallery scrolled into view
registry.result: Observer fallback, disconnect and declarative order preserved; browser visible entrance rendered.

registry.name: Shimmer
registry.contract: lines, circle, label
registry.result: Added missing visibility subscription; observer released after final unmount.

registry.name: Sparkles
registry.contract: count, color, children
registry.result: Deterministic particle layout and aria-hidden SVGs retained; browser composition rendered.

registry.name: Spotlight
registry.contract: as, color, radius, children
registry.result: Native pointer light composition retained; no independent timers or frame loop.

registry.name: Tilt
registry.contract: as, max, glare, children
registry.result: Reduced motion now prevents pointer rotation and resets CSS transforms/scaling.

registry.name: AudioPlayer
registry.contract: src, duration, playing/position for external engine, volume/defaultVolume/onVolumeChange, disabled, showVolume, transport callbacks
registry.result: Latest callbacks, complete disabled propagation and controlled-volume notification fixed. Track no longer collapses to zero and volume remains within narrow cards.

registry.name: KaraokeLyrics
registry.contract: current/next word arrays, message, line keys, kick/snare/pulse
registry.result: Current and next lines rendered; decorative music reactions preserved.

registry.name: LevelMeter
registry.contract: value 0–100 or stream, active, compact, label
registry.result: Existing silent-clock release, decay completion and cleanup tests pass. Actual microphone hardware not exercised.

registry.name: MediaCard
registry.contract: title, subtitle, image, levels, phase, badge, actions, tilt
registry.result: Composed card and clipped long title rendered; receives shared border and reduced-motion corrections.

registry.name: MelodyRoll
registry.contract: notes, position, window/defaultWindow/onWindowChange, lead, pitch range, livePitch, accuracy, hit IDs, level, beat, showLyrics, onKeyPress
registry.result: Composition rendered; piano keyboard accessibility and timer fixes propagate here.

registry.name: PianoKeyboard
registry.contract: minMidi/maxMidi, activeMidi, hit, labels all/octaves/none, onKeyPress
registry.result: Keyboard activation now emits once; repeated feedback uses one timer and unmount clears it.

registry.name: RotaryKnob
registry.contract: value/defaultValue, min/max, step/fineStep, change/commit, resetValue, diameter, xs/sm/md/lg, readOnly/disabled, showValue/showLabel, displayScale/suffix
registry.result: Hidden readout no longer disables control; disabled/readOnly stops input; unmount emits no commit; width fits container. Existing raster implementation retained, no new Canvas renderer introduced.

registry.name: Sparkline
registry.contract: values, fit, color, label; omitted data is demo, explicit [] is empty
registry.result: Empty data no longer fabricates demo values; offscreen animation registration added; bounded extrema-preserving large-series test passes.

registry.name: WaveDecoration
registry.contract: CommonProps; inherited color/size
registry.result: Cached 22 strand nodes retained; SVG scope no longer overwrites document-wide motion preference.

registry.name: Waveform
registry.contract: duration, position/defaultPosition/onSeek, points or src, bins, color, label, disabled
registry.result: Empty arrays show silence; value/aria agree; seek stops stuck playback decoration; primary pointer focus and cancellation handled.

registry.name: PianoRoll
registry.contract: notes/words, duration/position, selected, zoom/defaultZoom/onZoomChange, pitch range, follow/grid, selection/seek/nudge/drag callbacks
registry.result: Keyboard selects notes, secondary pointers cannot hijack a drag, cancellation sends zero offsets before end and never seeks/selects an area.

compatibilityNotes: AudioPlayer.onVolumeChange is additive; external-engine consumers can now pair it with volume.
Explicit empty Waveform/Sparkline arrays no longer display invented demo data; omit arrays for demo behavior.
PianoRoll cancellation reports zero offsets before onNoteDragEnd; handlers should apply offsets relative to the gesture start, as the existing contract specifies.
Marquee uses the native inert property in a ref to work with React18 and React19 JSX differences.
limits: No physical low-end PC, mobile device, touch screen, real microphone, or audio output hardware was available to this agent.
Owned browser checks use installed Chromium; Firefox and WebKit are not certified by these checks.
Four color themes were rendered; this file does not claim exhaustive contrast certification across every custom token override or high-contrast OS mode.
Browser gallery checks all23 families and critical interactions, not every Cartesian combination of all props.
Package installation, declaration output, React18/19 consumer, release artifact freshness and full final workspace suite are coordinated by the root agent.
